studioGuide.guideIntro: This guide walks you through where everything lives in the Studio and how to make changes to the website without breaking anything.

steps: Open "Blog" then "Posts" from the left navigation.
Click "New" (or the plus button) to start a post.
Fill in the title and the text of the preview, and pick the category "Sermon Preview".
Click Publish.
howTos.title: Post this week’s sermon preview

steps: Open "Site settings" from the left navigation.
Click the "Church details" tab at the top of the form.
Edit the service time or office hours field.
Click Publish.
howTos.title: Change the service time or office hours

steps: Open "People" then "Staff members" from the left navigation.
Click "New" to add someone, or open an existing person to edit or remove them.
Set their group (Pastors, Church Coordination Team, or Support and volunteer roles).
Click Publish.
howTos.title: Add or remove a staff member

steps: Open "Pages" then "Home" from the left navigation.
Open the first section at the top of the page layout.
Find the Photos field and upload the new image, or remove the old one.
Click Publish.
howTos.title: Change a photo on the home page

steps: The site rebuilds itself in about two minutes.
Nobody needs to be called. The change appears on its own once the rebuild finishes.
howTos.title: What happens when I press Publish

steps: "Remove field": it deletes that information from every page.
If you see it next to something, leave it alone and ask for help instead.
howTos.title: The one button never to press

steps: Open the Media library and click Upload.
Photos of children need a signed consent form on file at the office before they go up.
howTos.title: Add a photo to the Staff page or a blog post

studioMap.description: The sections on the front page of the site: the photo and headline at the top, and everything below it. Drag to reorder, or add and remove sections from the same screen.
What a first-time visitor needs to know before they come: service time, address, what to expect, and parking. Set once, changed rarely.
Who We Are, Beliefs, and History live under Pages too, built from the same section library as the home page.
Sermon previews and church news. Each post has a title, a category, and the text of the post. New posts appear on the Blog page automatically.
Everyone on the Staff page: pastors, the coordination team, and support and volunteer roles. Each one has a name, role, photo, and short bio.
The church’s groups and programs, like Children or Outreach. Each one has a name, a short summary, and a longer description.
The church’s name, service time, office hours, address, and the links in the header and footer. Most of the site reads from here.

tips.body: Open Site settings first and check the service time, office hours, address, and contact details are correct. Most of the site reads from here.
tips.heading: Start with Site settings

tips.body: The Preview tool is the easiest way to work. You see the real page, click the thing you want to change, and the right field opens. You can also add, reorder, and remove whole sections without leaving the page. Everything you do there is a draft until you press Publish.
tips.heading: Edit on the page, not in a list of fields

tips.body: When you click Publish, the site rebuilds itself in about two minutes. There is no staging step and nobody needs to be called. If you want to draft something before it goes live, leave it as a draft and come back to it.
tips.heading: Publishing is not instant, but it is automatic

tips.body: Before adding a photo of a child to the Staff page or a blog post, check that a signed consent form is on file at the office.
tips.heading: Photos of children need a consent form on file first

tips.body: If a screen looks wrong, or you see a "Remove field" button, stop and ask for help rather than guessing. Nothing else in the Studio can be broken by clicking around.
tips.heading: Stuck? Ask before you delete anything
